description: Hero background illustration for top page
prompt: Abstract illustration with flowing blobs and gentle circles in a wide horizontal composition. Eight vivid bright colors blend together: blue (#3b82f6), green (#22c55e), orange (#f97316), pink (#ec4899), purple (#a855f7), coral red (#f87171), yellow (#facc15), and cyan (#06b6d4). Flat smooth gradient style, clean vector-like shapes. Smooth edges, not fuzzy. Large soft round shapes flowing like ocean waves. On a very dark navy-violet (#0a0a1f) background. Vivid colors on dark background. Warm and inviting atmosphere, dreamy night ocean feeling. Headspace-inspired minimal flat design. No watercolor texture, no paint strokes. No characters, no people, no text, no objects, no shadows, no realistic textures, no light effects.
